brief: DAD.LOG per-entry attachment for RECEIPTS.SCN (dadlog-archive-reader ui-spec, section F, ROUND 3 addendum). A fanned strip of small dated pharmacy receipt stubs, overlapping like a hand of cards or a fan of ticket stubs, resting loose in or half-spilling out of a plain cardboard shoebox (canon detail: found in a shoebox, six years of dated stubs). Each stub shows the faint suggestion of a printed header and a few line-item rows, all rendered as ILLEGIBLE printed-line texture (short flat rule marks standing in for text and numerals, never actual readable characters - the dither must crush it to texture). 1990s anime OVA ink style, flat cel shading, clean high-contrast linework so the overlapping stub edges and the shoebox's corrugated texture read clearly after 1-bit dithering. Absolutely NO readable text, NO panel borders, NO speech bubbles anywhere; background a plain flat dark surface, nothing else in frame.
